headerDisplay: Local control of a Tuya-based Modern Flames electric fireplace on your home network. No cloud. Creates up to four tiles: **Fireplace** (power), **Fireplace Heat**, **Fireplace Lights** (Flames, Ember Bed, Downlight) and **Flame Effects**. You need the fireplace's device ID and local key: see [Finding the device ID and local key](https://github.com/dlev02/homebridge-modern-flames#finding-the-device-id-and-local-key). Add one entry per fireplace.
footerDisplay: Lights and effects can never turn the fireplace on. Only **Fireplace** and **Fireplace Heat** can.

name.title: Name
name.description: Used for the tiles: "<Name>", "<Name> Heat" and "<Name> Lights". Use a different name for each fireplace.

deviceId.title: Device ID
deviceId.description: Tuya device ID (shown in the Tuya IoT Platform device list).

ip.title: IP address
ip.description: Give the fireplace a fixed (reserved) address in your router.

key.title: Local key
key.description: 16-character local key. Removing and re-adding the fireplace in the app changes it.

protocolVersion.title: Protocol version
protocolVersion.description: Tuya LAN protocol version. Modern Flames fireplaces seen so far use 3.3.

showColorCycle.title: Show Ember Bed and Downlight color-cycle switches

cosmeticWhileOff.title: Color and effect changes while the fireplace is off

oneOf.title: Save them and apply when the fireplace turns on (safe default)
Send them right away (only if tested not to wake the fireplace)
